decision_text: Narrow the tender service to a single-notice, source-verified bid/no-bid brief sold per notice to low-frequency bidders who have exhausted free AI reports and do not need a GBP 990/month subscription. Retain the live pages unchanged; the unsent offer text is in offer-en-fr.md. Condition: at least one classified request or explicit price question attributable to a tender page; otherwise do not build more tender inventory.
price_hypothesis: CAD 49 per notice (unvalidated hypothesis, unchanged from existing welfare offer; roughly 5% of Stotles Growth monthly price; no evidence of willingness to pay)

dependencies.acquisition: No outbound channel; only live Cloudflare pages + private mail intake. Commercial feedback 0 classified / 5 unclassified (unknown, not zero). Any page change needs independent exact-digest review.
dependencies.order_acceptance: Administrative only (orders_admin.py); agents cannot create/accept orders (blocker SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION).
dependencies.settlement: Interac CAD READY_FOR_INSTRUCTIONS; deposit needs founder attestation; no bank API; no receipts.

reconsideration_trigger: A classified request/price question on a tender page, or official evidence of per-report pricing by an incumbent that undercuts CAD 49.
